source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, perfectly flat surface filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Multi-ply ballistic giant-spider dragline silk cloth at 20 cm square garment scale, woven from thick cable-twisted high-tensile silk cords into a dense hexagonal honeycomb-twill ripstop grid (twelve hex cells across) with a tough pearlescent fibre relief. Neutral mid-grey (#8a8a8a), fully desaturated: no brown, tan or warm cast; only the light and dark relief of the weave so it can be tinted to any palette colour.
